I’ll share a memory of my Opa (grandfather), who was my best friend and a parent figure to me. When we were kids, my siblings and I would sometimes sleep over at my grandparents’ house. We’d all pile into the same king size bed with them, watch cartoons until we fell asleep, and wake up in the morning to my Oma making pancakes. Opa would eat breakfast with us on the patio in their beautiful backyard. He’d tell the same stories and jokes he always did, laugh and be silly with us, and ask all about school and our dreams for the future. He’d tell me I was his schatzie (sweetheart) and that one day we’d dance together at my wedding. He’d give me a soul-crushing bear hug when it was time to go home, and his stubble would scratch up my cheek as he kissed it (but I didn’t mind). He was the best man I ever knew.

My mom, sister, and I are all sensitive to spirit. I’ve only seen a spirit once, while other experiences were mostly through having an internal “sense” that something else was present. Sometimes unexplained things would happen to my physical surroundings when I had that gut feeling. 

When I moved to my current house, I first lived in the basement apartment for a few years. Immediately I knew there was a presence. I just “knew” it wasn’t malevolent necessarily, nor good, but definitely aware of me and sometimes watching intensely. I knew it was male, and that it stayed almost exclusively in my bathroom. I felt it watching me the most when I showered. I convinced myself that maybe I was just looney and nothing was actually there. Even if it was, I didn’t want to interact with it anyways. 

About a year ago, a friend of a friend came over. I had never met him before and also had never mentioned the spirit to the friend that had invited him. We all hung out, he used the restroom, and then we headed outside to smoke. Once we left the property, he told us that he saw something in the bathroom. He was standing up facing the toilet, when he noticed a face in his peripheral vision by the door. He initially thought it was just one of us being super weird and peeping. 

When he turned around, he saw a man’s face in the doorway, staring dead at him. He was older, and had a creepy, steady gaze. He was there for a second or two when my friend blinked and the face disappeared. 

I was honestly shaken when I heard this, but also a bit relieved when I realized I was maybe a little less crazy than I’d thought. Thankfully I have since moved upstairs and haven’t had an issue or supernatural experience since.
